_comments: APOLLO.IO as an Enrichment Provider (plan §8.4). DriverClass 'Apollo' is the @RegisterClass key of
ApolloEnrichmentProvider in @mj-biz-apps/common-enrichment. IntegrationID points at the 'Apollo'
MJ: Integrations row (seeded by MemberJunction) so a company credential can carry the key; with none,
APOLLO_API_KEY. MaxBatchSize 10 is Apollo's people/bulk_match ceiling. RequestsPerMinute 20 is the
free plan's limit (Phase 0 S5: 20/min, 100/hour, 600/day; the paid plan reported 1,000/min): a
conservative seed that still sends 200 people a minute; an admin on a paid plan can raise it.
CreditPrice ships empty: every host's contract differs, so estimates say 'unpriced' until an admin
enters one. Rate rows below carry only numbers Phase 0 confirmed (S4, S7, 2026-10-12).
No sync block: the release push writes that back. primaryKeys from uuidgen.

fields.Name: Apollo.io
fields.Description: Employment history and LinkedIn URLs from Apollo.io people/bulk_match. One credit per matched person; a miss is free. Apollo returns no education (Phase 0, 2026-10-12), so that facet comes from People Data Labs.

fields.Notes: Phase 0 S4, 2026-10-12: credits_consumed 5 for 5 matches of 6 on people/bulk_match; a miss is free.
Phase 0 S7, 2026-10-12: no credits charged and no credit headers on mixed_people/api_search, on a free and a paid key.
Phase 0 S7, 2026-10-12: same as Count; api_search results are obfuscated, so details need a paid Enrich by id.

_comments: PEOPLE DATA LABS as an Enrichment Provider (plan §8.4). DriverClass 'PDL' is the @RegisterClass key of
PDLEnrichmentProvider. IntegrationID points at the 'People Data Labs' MJ: Integrations row (seeded by
MemberJunction); with no company credential, PDL_API_KEY. MaxBatchSize 100 is person/bulk's ceiling.
RequestsPerMinute null: PDL reports its limits in headers (Phase 0 P6: 100/min on the free plan) and
the client turns a 429 into a clean stop. Configuration MinLikelihood 6 is PDL's documented default.
CreditPrice ships empty; PDL's 2026 list price was reported at about $0.20 to $0.28 per credit depending
on plan (unverified) — enter the contract price here, never a guess. Rate rows carry only numbers Phase 0
confirmed (P6, P8, P9, P10, 2026-10-12). No sync block. primaryKeys from uuidgen.

fields.Name: People Data Labs
fields.Description: Education, employment history and LinkedIn URLs from People Data Labs person/bulk. One credit per matched person; a miss is free. Education is in the data on every plan (Phase 0, 2026-10-12). List price reported at about $0.20 to $0.28 per credit in 2026 depending on plan; enter the contract price in CreditPrice.

fields.Notes: Phase 0 P6, 2026-10-12: x-call-credits-spent equals the number of 200s in person/bulk; misses free.
Phase 0 P8, 2026-10-12: a size-1 person/search spent 1 search credit when something matched, nothing otherwise.
Phase 0 P9, 2026-10-12: one search credit per record returned by person/search.
Phase 0 P10, 2026-10-12: autocomplete and school/clean return no credit headers; rate-limited only.
